evidence_policy.automated_nonproduction: Deterministic component and runtime-wiring assertions only; quality remains NOT_MEASURED.
evidence_policy.production: Requires a precommitted independent dataset and rubric, source-bound runtime observations, and the immutable raw output of an external grader bound to the same HEAD, TREE, release, run, attempt and closure manifests.
evidence_policy.human_calibration: Requires an external candidate-bound review artifact covering at least 20 distinct blinded Hong Kong customer-service samples and two reviewers; AWAITING until valid reviews are collected and threshold/disagreement checks pass.
